Secure Pocket uses the Vosk Android runtime 0.3.47 and the small US English model 0.15 from Alpha Cephei under Apache License 2.0. The model archive is bundled in app/src/main/assets and extracted into private storage on first use.

The Android runtime uses JNA 5.13.0, distributed under LGPL 2.1 or later or Apache License 2.0. This distribution uses the Apache license option.

Sources: https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models, https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api, https://github.com/java-native-access/jna.

Vosk's bundled speaker comparison model, vosk-model-spk-0.4, is from Alpha Cephei and distributed under Apache License 2.0. Voice vectors and speaker names remain in the phone library metadata.
